visual_character.en: warm loess and gray brick tones

visual_character.zh: 拱门街道中的密集市井纹理
visual_character.en: dense market texture under arched streets

visual_character.zh: 沉稳厚重的历史体量感
visual_character.en: historical depth with grounded material weight

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 宽厚城墙、城门体量、砖石质感和线性延展
landmarks.visual_description_en: broad fortified walls, gate massing, brick-and-stone texture, and long linear extension

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 重檐木楼、中心广场位置和对称结构感
landmarks.visual_description_en: tiered timber tower massing with central placement and strong structural symmetry

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 高台、檐口和厚重历史建筑比例
landmarks.visual_description_en: raised platform, layered eaves, and weighty historical proportions

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 陶俑队列、土色材质和沉默雕塑感
landmarks.visual_description_en: terracotta figure formations, earthen surfaces, and still sculptural gravity

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 宽直道路、仪式性空间和古都轴线尺度
landmarks.visual_description_en: broad straight avenues, ceremonial spatial rhythm, and imperial axial scale

architecture.visual_description_zh: 厚重砖面、开阔墙体和古城防御感
architecture.visual_description_en: massive gray brick surfaces with defensive scale and grounded urban presence

architecture.visual_description_zh: 深拱洞口、城门阴影和历史穿行感
architecture.visual_description_en: deep arched passageways with gate shadow and historical transition

architecture.visual_description_zh: 深色木构、上扬檐线和礼制建筑细节
architecture.visual_description_en: dark timber structure, lifted eave lines, and ceremonial architectural detailing

architecture.name_en: courtyard roofs in the old quarter
architecture.visual_description_zh: 连续屋脊、低矮院落和历史生活肌理
architecture.visual_description_en: continuous roof ridges, low courtyard compounds, and old-quarter domestic texture

architecture.visual_description_zh: 密集店招、木门面和有层次的老街界面
architecture.visual_description_en: dense old-street facades, timber shopfronts, and layered muslim-quarter street edges

food.visual_description_zh: 宽厚手工面带、红油点缀和有力量的食物线条
food.visual_description_en: broad hand-pulled noodle ribbons with chili accents and strong graphic movement

food.visual_description_zh: 烤馍外壳、夹肉纹理和手持食物感
food.visual_description_en: toasted bread crust, layered meat filling, and tactile hand-held form

food.visual_description_zh: 白碗、掰馍颗粒和温热汤面质感
food.visual_description_en: white bowls, torn bread texture, and warm broth surfaces

food.visual_description_zh: 金黄表面、平整小饼和温暖甜点色调
food.visual_description_en: golden cake surfaces, round pastry forms, and warm dessert tones

food.visual_description_zh: 木签、孜然粉色调和夜市烟火质感
food.visual_description_en: wood skewers, cumin-spice palettes, and grounded street-food heat

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 宽袖、华丽纹样、发饰和盛唐礼制视觉
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: wide sleeves, rich ornament motifs, hair accessories, and Tang ceremonial styling

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 镂空人物、透光材质和侧向戏剧轮廓
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: cutout puppet figures, translucent materials, and side-lit theatrical silhouettes

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 纸张、墨迹、碑石和历史文脉手感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: paper textures, black ink traces, stone-rubbing surfaces, and scholarly historical tactility

craft_and_culture.name_en: traditional drum and ritual performance objects
craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 鼓面、木架和古都礼仪表演的仪式感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: drum skins, timber frames, and ritual-performance ceremonial weight

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 面案、炉火和手工饼食制作动作
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: dough boards, oven heat, and visible handcraft bread-making gestures

nature.name_en: ancient ginkgo trees in temple courtyards
nature.visual_description_zh: 高大银杏、金黄叶色和古院静谧感
nature.visual_description_en: tall ancient ginkgo trees, golden foliage, and quiet temple-courtyard stillness

nature.name_en: autumn dry light over city walls
nature.visual_description_zh: 干净秋光、低饱和空气和砖墙暖调
nature.visual_description_en: dry autumn light, low-humidity clarity, and warm-toned wall surfaces

nature.visual_description_zh: 黄土色地面、稀疏植被和西北边缘感
nature.visual_description_en: loess-toned ground, sparse vegetation, and a northwestern peripheral landscape feel

nature.visual_description_zh: 远处山线、浅蓝灰色调和古都之外的自然背景
nature.visual_description_en: distant Qinling foothills with pale blue-gray layering beyond the city

nature.visual_description_zh: 略带尘感的冬季天空、柔化光线和历史城市氛围
nature.visual_description_en: dust-softened winter sky with muted light and a grounded historical atmosphere

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 古都场景应体现城防尺度、轴线感或唐代物质线索
must_include_when_relevant.en: ancient-capital scenes should show fortified scale, axial depth, or Tang-era material cues

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 食物场景应明显体现陕西地方食物身份，而不是泛化中国街头小吃
must_include_when_relevant.en: food scenes should feel Shaanxi-specific rather than generic Chinese street food

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 历史场景应以砖石、土色和厚重材料感为主，而不是光鲜的幻想宫殿画法
must_include_when_relevant.en: historical scenes should use grounded brick, stone, or earthen tones instead of glossy fantasy grandeur

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 不要把西安压缩成单一钟楼明信片
avoid_generic_patterns.en: do not reduce Xi'an to one bell tower postcard

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 避免把所有场景都画成泛化古风宫殿幻想图
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid turning all scenes into generic ancient-Chinese palace fantasy

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 除非场景确实相关，避免过度滥用兵马俑形象
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid overusing Terracotta Army figures outside explicitly relevant historical compositions

cover_bias.zh: 西安封面适合在历史重量感和一个清晰主体之间找到平衡
cover_bias.en: Xi'an works well when historical weight is paired with one readable subject and strong geometry

cover_bias.zh: 食物手艺和回民街生活纹理可以中和过于宏大的古都封面方向
cover_bias.en: food craft and muslim-quarter street texture can counterbalance overly monumental cover directions

scene_balance_notes.zh: 在城墙与古都礼制之外，也要保留老城生活和食物工艺方向
scene_balance_notes.en: balance fortified history with lived old-city atmosphere

scene_balance_notes.zh: 礼制与历史大场景控制在一到两种，其余应分散到街巷、食物、手艺和院落
scene_balance_notes.en: use only one or two highly ceremonial scenes, then diversify with street, food, craft, and courtyard directions
